points.why: Explicitly names the 'success to the successful' structure.
Explains that the rule compounds the early lucky edge and that past papers partly record past allocation, so the argument is circular.
Recommends changing the rule with a per-group floor, needs-based allocation, and discounting allocation-driven output.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly rejects past output as proof of merit and proposes per-student measures instead.
Never calls it Escalation and correctly frames the dynamic as the allocation rule, not mutual reaction.
